architecture_contract.method: non-neural mosaic topology traversal using reference PCA or LDA scores, shared-feature linear projections, and optional intermediate PCA hops
architecture_contract.native_query_classifier: adaptive or fixed k-nearest-neighbor label transfer in the joint embedding
architecture_contract.native_imputation: mean by default over reference-cell nearest neighbours in the StabMap embedding
architecture_contract.warning: The upstream defaults center and scale every supplied dataset and finally recenter the combined reference-plus-query embedding. Those steps make coordinates depend on the held query population unless replaced by training-reference transforms.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No pretrained checkpoint exists. Fit reference scores and projection operators only from outer-training references and bridges.

inductive_inference_contract.allowed_wrapper: Use training-only reference datasets and bridge matrices, provide or derive training-only reference scores, make every held dataset a terminal query leaf, set scale.center=false and scale.scale=false, and apply frozen upstream assay transforms.
inductive_inference_contract.combined_centering_fix: Replace upstream final reference-plus-query colMean centering with a training-reference-only origin and prove a query cannot move any reference coordinate, classifier coefficient, prototype, or neighbour index.
inductive_inference_contract.forbidden: Held queries cannot be references or intermediate bridges, cannot select reference features, cannot alter topology among training nodes, and cannot contribute labels, scaling, PCA/LDA, k selection, or calibration.
inductive_inference_contract.native_lane: classifyEmbedding may transfer training-reference labels after the leakage-safe embedding is frozen; common lane uses an identical benchmark head instead.

input_contract.assay_input: named list of feature-by-cell matrices or SummarizedExperiment assays with unique dataset names, unique cell identifiers across list elements, and explicit feature row names
input_contract.bridge_requirement: The feature-overlap topology must be connected through training-only bridge datasets. For RNA and peak spaces, a validated same-nucleus stacked bridge or training-only ATAC gene-activity bridge is required.
input_contract.reference: GENCODE v49 genes and GRCh38.p14 peak coordinates with modality namespaces and frozen assay-native transformations
input_contract.warning: StabMap requires every cell column name across assay_list elements to be unique. A paired RNA/ATAC bridge must be represented as one validated stacked feature matrix, not duplicate cell columns in two list elements.

missingness_contract.dataset_level: Missing assays are structural because datasets expose only their measured feature rows; no missing assay is represented as a zero block.
missingness_contract.project_mapping: Retain all eight project states outside StabMap. Only observed features enter matrices; unresolved, below-QC, permission, withheld, and structural states remain distinguishable in manifests.
missingness_contract.limitation: StabMap does not natively carry per-entry project missing-state masks.

output_contract.common_embedding: training-reference-anchored joint PC embedding for terminal RNA query cells
output_contract.imputation: nearest-reference feature imputation is a native diagnostic, not an admitted RNA-conditioned ATAC profile
output_contract.profile_status: latent-only under the frozen RNA-conditioned ATAC capability registry

runtime_contract.declared_r: >=4.4.0; Bioconductor 3.23 release tooling may impose a newer campaign R that must be frozen

safe_loading_contract.required_artifacts: Plain matrices and manifests for reference scores, projection coefficients, feature lists, bridge topology, centering origin, labels/head, and hashes; do not accept external serialized R objects.

source_evidence: The exact Bioconductor StabMap 1.6.0 release branch commit, DESCRIPTION, core R sources, public package metadata, and official documentation were inspected as text on 2026-08-22. The source archive, packages, fitted objects, and model data were not downloaded, installed, deserialized, or executed.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Eligible as a classical reference-mapping candidate only after the terminal-query, frozen-transform, training-reference centering, bridge, and no-query-influence fixtures pass.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Latent-only in the current registry. Native nearest-neighbour imputation cannot be scored as a profile champion.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible because StabMap has no DNA sequence or allele-effect mechanism.
